title: Peter Jackson Talks Upcoming Projects, AI’s Role in Filmmaking: “It’s Just a Tool Like Any Other”
summary: In Cannes to accept an honorary Palme d'Or, the director teased his long-awaited return to narrative features with 'Tintin' and WWII projects in the works, while also sharing some thoughts on Andy Serkis' forthcoming 'The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum.'
